blaine-lgpe: Burn lasts two extra turns has no effect: burns never wear off in this game.
calem: Mega Evolution costs 20% less has no effect: Mega Evolution costs nothing in this game (the stone is the only requirement).
brigette: Storage is the new PC (6 slots, map button).
bill: The PC works anywhere on the map between battles, not only at Pokémon Centers.
elm: Newly hatched Pokémon start three levels higher and gain 15% more EXP has no effect: the game has no egg hatching yet.
emmet: Double battles grant 25% more rewards has no effect: the game has no double battles yet. (Multi-target moves are the spread list in trainerPerks.ts.)
ginter: Rare items appear 20% more often in shops: one extra locked (later-unlocking) item is on sale early, since shop stock is a fixed list.
giacomo: Status moves are 15% more effective: read as +15% accuracy for your status moves.
gladion-stance: Switching grants 10% damage reduction for one turn: read as 10% less damage taken on a Pokémon's first turn after it comes in (the turn it switches in and its first acting turn).
hau-stance: Switching grants a small shield: read as the same 10% damage reduction on the first turn after switching in.
ilima: Status moves are 10% more effective: read as +10% accuracy for your status moves.
harmony: Friendship bonuses are 20% stronger: Return power and friendship-gated Hyper moments count friendship 20% higher.
hilda: Fire-types and physical attackers: two separate boosts, so a Fire-type using a physical move gets both.
ingo: Double battles grant 20% more rewards has no effect: the game has no double battles yet. Single battles grant 10% less EXP applies to every battle (all battles are single).
green-classic: Starters start one level lower (never below level 1).
